Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by earnings and broader economic signals. Tech and chip names, especially leveraged ones, are sensitive to any hint of slowdown.

Your holdings: SMCI (-18.94%) and MU (-29.47%) are flagged for attention. SOXL (-54.06%) and SPAL (-26.04%) are deep in the red, amplified by margin. These leveraged ETFs are particularly vulnerable to drawdowns.

Watch: Keep an eye on IBM and Tesla earnings, as they can set the tone for tech. Moderna's cancer vaccine results could also be a wildcard.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and protecting capital in this choppy environment.
plays: SMCI: Consider trimming exposure given the SELL status and current price below the stop.
SOXL: Re-evaluate stop loss given significant drawdown and leveraged nature.
PLTR: Watch for entry between 199.89-199.69 with stop at 198.55 if market conditions support.
